text: 随着上市公司2026年半年报披露完毕，QFII最新持仓也浮出水面。数据显示，2026年中报披露完毕，共有52家QFII出现在1724家A股公司的前十大流通股东名单中，持仓市值合计超过3400亿元，较一季度末增加超1917亿元。从持股变化来看，相较一季度末，QFII新进950只个股、增持379只、减持371只。从最新持仓变化来看，海外投资者对中国市场的关注度明显回升。业内人士认为，政策落地效果、上市公司盈利变化以及海外利率等因素，仍将影响外资的阶段性配置节奏。但从中长期看，随着中国资本市场开放机制进一步完善，以及更多优质资产持续涌现，人民币资产对境外长期资
text_en: With the completion of 2026 interim report disclosures, QFII latest holdings have emerged. Data shows 52 QFIIs appeared among the top ten circulating shareholders of 1,724 A-share companies, with total holdings exceeding 340 billion yuan, up over 191.7 billion yuan from end-Q1. Compared to Q1-end, QFIIs newly entered 950 stocks, increased stakes in 379, and reduced in 371. The shifts indicate overseas investors' renewed interest in the Chinese market. Insiders note that policy implementation effects, corporate earnings changes, and overseas interest rates will still influence foreign capital's phased allocation pace, but long-term, improved capital market opening mechanisms and more quality assets will sustain RMB assets' appeal to overseas long-term investors.
